{
  "root_causes": [
    "The normalization function incorrectly collapses whitespace runs in the normalized string before mapping back to original spans, causing misalignment when original text contains mixed whitespace types (e.g., \\t, \\xa0) that map to a single space in normalized form.",
    "The span reconstruction logic assumes a 1:1 character-to-normalized-character mapping, failing when multiple original characters (like \\t and \\xa0) collapse into a single normalized space, leading to incorrect start/end index calculation.",
    "The verification step rejects valid matches because the reconstructed original span includes multiple whitespace characters that normalize to a single space, but the logic does not account for the collapsed whitespace in the normalized query."
  ],
  "required_changes": [
    "Modify the normalization function to preserve the original whitespace structure during the mapping phase, ensuring that collapsed whitespace in the normalized string is correctly traced back to the original multi-character whitespace runs.",
    "Update the span reconstruction logic to handle cases where multiple original characters map to a single normalized character (e.g., multiple whitespace characters collapsing to one space), ensuring the original span includes all contributing characters.",
    "Adjust the verification step to correctly validate matches by ensuring the normalized version of the original span (including all whitespace characters) equals the normalized query, even when whitespace is collapsed."
  ],
  "concrete_counterexample_simulation": [
    "Input: source text 'X\\t \\xa0B' (with \\t, space, \\xa0), query 'a b'. Normalized source: 'x a b', normalized query: 'a b'. The normalized match 'a b' starts at index 2 in the normalized string, but the original span must include \\t, space, and \\xa0 (indices 1 to 6) to normalize to 'a b'. Current logic",
    "The current code calculates orig_start as 1 (correct) but fails to include all whitespace characters (\\t, space, \\xa0) in the end calculation, resulting in an incorrect span that does not normalize to 'a b'.",
    "Expected: match with start=1, end=6, quote='\\t \\xa0B'. Actual: no match because the reconstructed span does not normalize correctly due to incomplete whitespace inclusion."
  ],
  "preserved_invariants": [
    "IDs must be non-empty strings and unique within their respective lists.",
    "Query texts cannot be empty or consist solely of whitespace.",
    "Normalization is applied character-by-character (NFKC then casefold) before whitespace collapsing.",
    "Whitespace runs are collapsed to a single ASCII space; no trimming or punctuation removal occurs.",
    "Matches are identified in the normalized domain but reported as original Unicode code-point spans [start, end).",
    "A match is valid only if the normalized version of the original substring exactly equals the normalized query."
  ]
}
